description: Offline normalization of verified Connecticut childcare source candidates, with explicit address and identity uncertainty and no source requests.
redirect_policy: No network requests or redirects. Independently verify retained inputs inside datahub.
retry: No automatic retry or source repull. Verification failures preserve acquired inputs for inspection and explicit offline reprocessing.
checkpoint: Replay verified acquired evidence; publish derived records, quarantine and summary in an immutable UUID directory with manifest last.
idempotency: Bind exact acquisition manifest and transformation version; never overwrite acquired inputs or earlier normalized releases.
cancellation: Cooperative replay/normalization checks and drained owned writes. Clean only owned incomplete output and preserve uncertain publication.
retention_profile: Internal source-linked candidates and quarantine references. Preserve missing address/name/state gaps, opaque source keys, raw temporal and capacity evidence without merging credentials.
